items.note: Pure rename, behavior unchanged: the input always took a full Date and the calendar opens on its month with grid focus on its exact day (only when the value is empty; never written to the value). [defaultMonth] -> [defaultDate]. No other component has a defaultMonth input.

ds-table row hover tint is now rendered ONLY when rowInteractive is set (clickable rows also gain a pressed :active fill via --ds-table-row-pressed-bg-color). Was: every table tinted rows on hover. No code compiles differently — visual/behavior only. If a passive table must keep the old always-on hover, add consumer CSS: ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background-color: var(--surface-secondary); }. Tables that already set rowInteractive need no action.

informational: ds-table gains an opt-in rowActions kebab (⋮) column with a rowActionSelected output and new TableRowAction/TableRowActionEvent types — additive, off by default (no rowActions input = no column), no code change.

ds-table gains opt-in activeRowId (current-row highlight + aria-current, --ds-table-row-active-bg-color token) and filterQuery (client-side substring filter; TableColumn.filterable restricts the match set) inputs — additive, off by default, no code change.

TableColumn.width / .truncate / .hidden were declared but ignored — they now take effect (header width px, ellipsis clip at width with title tooltip, column skipped). Consumers who set these fields expecting nothing will see them start working.

TableColumn.hideable now works too: hideable columns surface a header column-picker button (checkbox popover, last visible column locked); new two-way hiddenKeys model (Set<string> | null, null derives from hidden flags) — additive, no picker unless a column sets hideable.
ds-table gains a public exportCsv(filename?) method — downloads visible columns of the filtered+sorted rows as UTF-8 CSV, wired to a consumer button via template ref — additive, no code change.

ds-table gains opt-in density ('default'|'compact'), zebra (odd-row stripe via new --ds-table-row-stripe-bg-color token) and maxHeight (caps + vertically scrolls the body, pairs with stickyHeader) inputs — additive, off by default, no code change.

ds-table gains an opt-in stickyScrollbar input — the scroll container's native horizontal bar is hidden and a proxy stuck to the bottom of the nearest scroll ancestor mirrors scrollLeft both ways (hides itself when nothing overflows) — additive, off by default, no code change.

ds-table truncate cells: clicking a clipped cell now opens the full value in a popover (title tooltip unchanged; the click is swallowed, never doubling as a row click; unclipped cells pass the click to the row) — behavior only, no code change.

ds-table rowInteractive: a click that finishes a mouse text selection no longer emits rowClicked, so cell text can be drag-selected and copied (only a selection made by that same gesture counts — a stale selection never blocks clicks); keyboard activation unaffected — behavior only, no code change.

ds-select/ds-autocomplete/ds-multi-select/ds-time-picker/ds-color-picker/ds-popover overlay panels are now non-modal (no backdrop): the page behind stays interactive, panels close on outside pointer-down or page scroll, button-style triggers toggle, and focus returns to the trigger only for Escape/selection/in-panel closes — behavior only, no code change.
ds-toast enter animation now slides up from below into place (exit unchanged) — visual/motion only, no code change.

ds-input/ds-search/ds-textarea now focus the inner input/textarea when the frame chrome is clicked (leading/trailing icon, prefix/suffix add-on, padding); nested controls (projected buttons, clear x, password toggle) keep their own click. New exported FieldClickFocusDirective ([dsFieldClickFocus]) for consumers' own field wrappers. Overlay-trigger fields already focused on click and are unchanged — behavior only, no code change.

New ds-app-shell — a slotted fixed-frame application shell ([sidenav]/[topbar]/default content slots) that pins to the viewport (100dvh, overflow: hidden) so only the content <main> scrolls (scrollbar-gutter: stable + automatic native-scrollbar-width padding compensation via the new --ds-scrollbar-width root variable); topbarSpan input ('content' default full-height rail | 'full' full-width topbar) switches the geometry; scroll-to-top on router navigation via the new exported ShellScrollService (also injectable from routed pages for manual scrollToTop()). Tokens: --ds-app-shell-pad-x/-pad-y/-content-max-width/-height — additive, no code change.

New ds-sidenav-footer — a rail footer brick: Search row with a live grouped-results popover, Alerts row with an unread dot + feed popover, Collapse row, and a user card with an account menu; inputs userName/userRole/alerts/collapsed/searchProvider/alertItems/profileRoute, outputs collapseToggled/alertsOpened/signOutSelected; new exported types SidenavSearchProvider/SidenavSearchResult/SidenavAlertItem. Tokens: --ds-sidenav-footer-popover-width/-popover-max-width/-popover-max-height/-head-tracking/-dot-size — additive, no code change.

ds-sidenav gains an optional logoLetter input (sets the brand-tile glyph when it differs from the brand's first letter) and a [dsBrandName] projection slot (exported marker directive BrandNameDirective) that renders custom wordmark markup inside .brand-name in place of the plain brand text — both optional, omitting them renders exactly as before, additive, no code change.
